label: Family-leave benefits — insured-unit days required
appliesTo: Counted before parental leave begins, but before maternity leave ends for the maternity benefit — the same number measured at two different moments. Unpaid days are excluded, and coverage under some non-employee schemes is not combined.
why: Not six calendar months. A worker with a valid visa, a salary and a contract can still be short, which is how people reach the application with the leave already booked and no benefit behind it.

history.source: Work24 — parental leave and maternity leave benefits
history.note: Distinct from the employer-service condition, which lets an employer refuse ordinary parental leave below six months' continuous service.
